line: Regulatory pressure in Seoul meets hardware security failure in wallets as Wall Street tests tokenized Treasuries and Russia readies Sberbank crypto trading.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.75% on the day, spot ETF net +175.7M USD (Oct 13, 2026), Fear & Greed 62 (greed), funding +0.0091% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: South Korea's regulators blocked 27 crypto exchange websites, including Bitmart and Kucoin, tightening restrictions on unregistered platforms.
Ledger confirmed LTE-enabled spy chips implanted in CryptoBilis-sold wallets transmitted user recovery phrases; MediaMarkt halted sales across Europe.
Russia's Sberbank won regulatory approval to offer crypto trading to all clients starting Dec. 1, beginning with BTC, ETH, and USDT.
